ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65:0.35 ratio of high-intensity white regions to low-intensity dark pigmentation across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs occupy the interior regions of both lobes. Low-intensity (black) pixels are concentrated at the fluke's center (peduncle junction), along the leading edges, and at the distal tips. A dense network of low-intensity linear filaments intersects the primary white blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a defined central convergence point; depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke vertical span in the current orientation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations along both lobes; amplitude increases towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges, transitioning to a sharp distal taper at the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered circular high-contrast clusters (white-on-black and black-on-white) located along the upper margin of the left lobe and the peripheral boundaries of both tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly dense detection of unaligned, multi-directional dark linear pixel disruptions across the ventral surface, with the highest concentration and length on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel dark linear scars on the right lobe; significant low-intensity pixel clusters and irregular texture at the extreme distal tips suggestive of recurring colonization or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-hatched linear pigmentation pattern on the medial-distal region of the right lobe.
